en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2754 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:
I asked Abu Ibrahim (as) about a man who enters Mecca once, twice, or three times in a year. What should he do?
Imam (as) said: "When he enters, he should do so in the state of ihram, reciting the Talbiyah, and when he leaves, he should exit in the state of non-ihram."
